subject: Vendor panel evaluation and sample testing plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor panel evaluation and sample testing plan

Team —

As we discussed in the security ops sync, Procurement wants a clearer sampling approach and a short list of vendors to invite to a panel for our annual appsec/red team assessment. I pulled together a draft evaluation template and a proposed sampling matrix (attached).

High-level asks for this thread:
- Agree on the panel composition (3 vendors max) by EOD Monday
- Confirm the sampling targets (modules, feature owners, production vs. staging)
- Flag any non-negotiable contract terms (insurance minimums, evidence transfer, E2E retention)

Notes / constraints: we want a mix of pure-play red teams and application-focused pen testers; FYI this engagement will include: a 2-week scoped red team window, one week of targeted appsec for core web services, and an evidence handoff for audit. Legal (Laura) is on copy for SOW constraints.

Attachments: vendor-eval-template.xlsx (xlsx, 68KB); sample-testing-matrix.csv (csv, 12KB)

Thanks —
Naomi
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
From: Vanguard Risk <engage@vanguard-risk.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor panel evaluation and sample testing plan

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the invite. Vanguard Risk would be happy to participate in a vendor panel. Quick notes from our side:
- We can provide a 3-person red team (lead + 2 ops) with a focused application tester and one infrastructure tester.
- Typical deliverables: attack narrative, chronicle timeline, prioritized remediation list, and evidence package with exploit artifacts.
- Insurance: we carry a $5M professional liability policy and can provide a certificate.
- SOW preference: time-and-materials up to a capped total with predefined milestones for exploit verification.

We reviewed the sampling matrix and suggest including session-replay endpoints and our newly deployed batch ingestion pipeline as high-priority items. Attached is a one-page company profile and staff bios.

Attachment: Vanguard-profile.pdf (pdf, 46KB)

Best,
Alex Raines
Engagement Lead, Vanguard Risk
engage@vanguard-risk.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jan 2027 13:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor panel evaluation and sample testing plan

Thanks Naomi —

Quick procurement input:
- We should require CVs for the specific testers who will run the assessment (not generic company bios). Please ask for those.
- Evidence handling: vendors must ship signed checksums and a step-by-step evidence handling plan. No cloud storage outside the agreed bucket until Legal approves.
- SOW: push for a 30-day remediation verification window and a fixed price option for the appsec slice (so we can budget to an exact figure).
- Budget: target not-to-exceed $120k for the combined engagement; show T&M with a cap if vendor prefers.

Action items:
- Naomi: include a line in the invite materials asking for tester CVs and their PII redaction plan.
- Karthik: validate the sampling matrix against current release carriers (I'll mark owners).
- Laura: if you have redlines for data-handling clauses, paste them here and we'll bake into the SOW draft.

Marissa
Head of AppSec
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Vanguard Risk <engage@vanguard-risk.com>, Cedar Red Team <partners@cedarred.com>, Stratify Security <info@stratify-security.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 31 Jan 2027 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Vendor panel evaluation and sample testing plan

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick responses. I've consolidated the asks and attached a short SOW draft and the evaluation template for you to complete ahead of the panel. Please provide the following by close of business next Thursday:
- CVs for the named testers who would be assigned to this engagement (redact personal numbers)
- A short evidence-handling checklist describing how artifacts will be transferred and retained (1 page)
- Confirmation of insurance limits and any exceptions
- A sample workplan that maps to our sampling matrix (CSV preferred)

I've also included a working SOW (sow-draft-red-team.docx) which includes a remediation-verification clause and a 30-day retest. Legal (Laura) has asked that we highlight any alternative language you need before we finalize.

Attachments: sow-draft-red-team.docx (docx, 42KB); sample-testing-matrix.csv (csv, 12KB)

Naomi
Director, Security Programs
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
